nodes.description: Public uint8 state variable holding the maximum number of whitelisted addresses allowed.
Public mapping(address => bool) tracking which addresses have been whitelisted.
Public uint8 counter of how many addresses have been whitelisted so far.
Constructor that initializes maxWhitelistedAddresses from the deployment argument.
Public function that whitelists the caller, enforcing duplicate and limit checks and incrementing the counter.
Caller-controlled address used as the mapping key and whitelist subject; can be any externally owned account or contract.
State increment numAddressesWhitelisted += 1 on a uint8 counter (arithmetic operations on bounded counter).
Constructor uint8 parameter providing the whitelist capacity limit.

edges.reason: The constructor parameter _maxWhitelistedAddresses is assigned directly into the maxWhitelistedAddresses state variable.
The constructor writes the initial value of maxWhitelistedAddresses.
msg.sender is used as the mapping key when writing whitelistedAddresses[msg.sender].
addAddressToWhitelist consumes the caller-supplied msg.sender as its only subject address.
msg.sender flows into the whitelisting branch that performs the numAddressesWhitelisted increment.
addAddressToWhitelist writes the whitelistedAddresses mapping to true for the caller.
The += 1 operation mutates the numAddressesWhitelisted counter; bounded uint8 arithmetic update.
addAddressToWhitelist guards against exceeding the whitelist and updates numAddressesWhitelisted.
The require(numAddressesWhitelisted < maxWhitelistedAddresses) check reads maxWhitelistedAddresses to bound whitelist growth.

normalization_plan.reason: The non-core constructor parameter _maxWhitelistedAddresses exists only to initialize maxWhitelistedAddresses inside the constructor, so it can be merged into the constructor function node.
